newsitem.title: USA: Matrix Pharm begins Phase II trials.
newsitem.headline: Matrix Pharm begins Phase II trials.

text.p: Matrix Pharmaceutical Inc said it has begun a Phase II trial of its IntraDose injectable gel in patients with metastatic liver cancer.
It also said it expects to initiate a second, similarly- designed Phase II trial in patients with primary liver cancer during the second quarter of this year.

Matrix also has IntraDose in Phase III trials as a treatment for head and neck cancer. IntraDose utilizes Matrix's patented Therapeutic Implant technology for delivering chemotherapeutic drugs directly into solid tumors and skin lesions.
